en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy open‑air market scene in a small town. Numerous women, men, and children in early 20th‑century clothing stand among stalls with baskets of produce and goods in front of low stone houses and a covered market hall with a tiled roof and bare trees. The caption at the top reads "CHELLES – Le Marché," and printer information appears at the bottom right.
